item.title: 面心立方高熵合金中变形与变化化学环境下空位形成的置换不变神经网络预测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tanvir Sohail, Swarnava Ghosh
该研究开发了一种原子尺度信息驱动、置换不变的机器学习框架，用于预测 FCC 高熵合金中随应变变化的空位形成能。模型结合空位中心局域几何描述符与局域变形梯度不变量，可统一学习化学无序和有限变形的耦合作用。结果显示体积变形主导平均空位形成能变化，而局域化学环境决定显著的位点间统计差异。

item.title: Cross-Geometry Transferability Assessment of Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: From Bulk Materials to Atomic Nanowires
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pedro H. M. Zanineli, Bruno Focassio, Gabriel R. Schleder
arXiv:2608.06662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable atomistic simulations at substantially lower computational cost than first-principles methods, but their reliability across structural geometries remains insufficiently understood. Here, we construct a density-functional-theory dataset of ZrO2 configurations spanning bulk, slab, particle, neck, and atomically thin wire environments motivated by an experimentally observed ZrO2 desintering process involving neck thinning and atomic wire formation. We first benchmark 26 pretrained MLIPs and observe pronounced geometry-dependent degradation in zero-shot predictions. Without any training, after only reference-energy alignment, the best zero-shot model (ORB-V3) reaches energy and fo…

item.title: 一种结合量子计算、神经网络与嵌入理论的通用泛函推导方法
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Martin J. Uttendorfer, Daniel Barragan-Yani, Matthias Sperl, Marc Landmann
本文提出一种结合量子计算、机器学习与约化密度矩阵泛函理论的新方法，目标是借助量子算法训练深度神经网络来获得通用泛函。作者进一步引入密度矩阵嵌入理论，以扩大可应用该泛函的哈密顿量范围，从而有望在量子化学与凝聚态物理中实现累积性的量子优势。

item.title: CrystalGRPO: Target-Aligned and Coverage-Preserving Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Based Crystal Structure Prediction
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kaixiang Su, Hongfei Xue, Qiang Zhu
arXiv:2608.06582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flow-based generative models can efficiently produce candidate structures for crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their pretrained objectives do not directly optimize downstream target recovery. Reinforcement-learning post-training offers a flexible solution, yet existing approaches rely primarily on energy rewards and coordinate-only stochastic policies. Predicted energy does not identify the reference polymorph, while reward-driven concentration can reduce the candidate coverage required for Top-N recovery. We introduce CrystalGRPO, a CSP-aligned post-training framework that extends existing ODE-to-SDE policy constructions to the joint coordinate--lattice state. CrystalGRPO combines MACE-predicted energy with a StructureMatcher-based r…

item.title: Quantum Feature Amplification Network (QFAN) as An Autoregressive Quantum Generative Model
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jamal Slim, Saverio Monaco, Florian Rehm, Dirk Kruecker, Kerstin Borras
arXiv:2605.16044v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Simulating calorimeter showers is one of the largest computing costs in high-energy physics, and quantum generative models have been proposed as compact alternatives. Their progress is blocked by a resource problem: in existing gate-model proposals the register must grow with the image, so benchmark geometries with thousands of cells are out of reach. We introduce the Quantum Feature Amplification Network (QFAN), which breaks the link between register size and image size. QFAN splits an image into consecutive blocks of b pixels and generates them one at a time, every block produced by the same small circuit conditioned on a fixed-length summary of the pixels already generated, so the qubit count is set by the block size rather than…

item.title: 结合傅里叶增强特征的物理信息神经网络迭代训练
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yulun Wu, Miguel Aguiar, Karl H. Johansson, Matthieu Barreau
神经网络倾向于先学习低频特征，这种谱偏置是物理信息神经网络训练中的经典难题。本文提出 IFeF-PINN，通过随机傅里叶特征增强潜在空间，并将训练拆分为基空间估计与增强基系数回归两个阶段。作者证明，在底层线性模型下后者是凸优化问题，且整个迭代训练过程收敛；实验还表明该方法在高频 PDE 逼近上具有更强表达能力。

item.title: 铁磁体-超导体异质结构中的自旋波输运理论：负折射、完美成像与温度控制的自旋波光学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tomas T. Osterholt, Thijs van der Meer, Pim H. Vree, Merel A. Bouma, Michael Borst, Toeno van der Sar, Rembert A. Duine
作者研究了铁磁绝缘体-超导体异质结构中的自旋波输运，并建立了适用于这类混合体系的自旋波光学理论框架。结果表明，超导体的迈斯纳屏蔽可导致负相速度和负群速度折射，以及与光学中不同的反射和折射定律。该框架还预言了可随温度调控的自旋波镜和折射元件，以及用于完美成像、波导和干涉器件的近乎平直等频线。

item.title: 拓扑陈带中铁磁体的非平衡自旋-谷动力学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 J. James, I. Krastilevskiy, F. Pichler, L. Wang, A. Iafarova, F. Menzel, K. Watanabe, T. Taniguchi, C. Kuhlenkamp, M. Knap, T. Smoleński
扭转 MoTe2 双层为研究远离平衡态的量子物质提供了有前景的平台，因为它同时具有强库仑相互作用、非平庸能带几何和光学控制能力。本文利用聚焦圆偏振光脉冲，在外磁场相反方向上创建局域磁畴，并在低温时空分辨实验中直接成像其后续的自旋-谷弛豫。结果表明，在整数与分数陈绝缘态附近，动力学机制与铁磁金属显著不同：陈畴不是通过收缩而塌缩，而是通过热激活“熔化”，因此其自旋演化过程和弛豫时间都明显不同且更长。

item.title: Spin-group theory on Edelstein effect and spin-orbit torque in Collinear Ferromagnets
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yizhuo Song, Qing Zhang, Jiahao Shentu, Jie Li, Jia Zhang
arXiv:2608.06964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current-induced spin-orbit torques (SOTs) are central to the electrical manipulation of magnetic order in spintronic devices. In transition-metal/collinear ferromagnet bilayers, field-like and damping-like torques have been described only phenomenologically via the spin or orbital Hall effect, lacking a rigorous symmetry-based foundation. The precise role of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in both the Edelstein effect and SOTs has remained unresolved. Here we develop a spin-group symmetry theory for the Edelstein effect and SOTs in collinear ferromagnets, treating SOC as a symmetry-breaking perturbation. For 4mm (C4v) point group symmetry, we derive the full forms of field-like and damping-like torques, which arise predominantly from first- and se…

item.title: Floquet spintronics: tuning the current-induced spin polarization of topological surface states with light
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Youngjae Kim, Aayushi Agrawal, Kwon Park
arXiv:2608.06786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological surface states are a promising platform for spintronics due to spin-momentum locking. Spin-momentum locking can induce a net spin polarization in topological surface states via an electric current, a phenomenon known as the Edelstein effect. In this work, using Floquet theory, we show that the current-induced spin polarization of topological surface states can be tuned by illuminating them with light, thereby modifying their spin texture in momentum space. Specifically, the electric spin susceptibility of topological surface states can be controlled and even reversed by varying the electric-field strength of high-frequency, circularly polarized light.

item.title: SSH 堆叠磁性层中的拓扑表面交替磁体
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rui Chen, Bin Zhou, Dong-Hui Xu
表面交替磁性为自旋电子学开辟了新方向，因为它能在常规反铁磁体的边界处解锁交替磁性的自旋分裂，从而绕开体交替磁体严格的对称性要求。本文提出通过按 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模式堆叠磁性层来构造拓扑表面交替磁体。我们表明，虽然体系体相是一个由 PT 对称保护能带简并的标准反铁磁体，但边界处局域对称性的破缺会在拓扑能隙中产生受拓扑保护的表面交替磁性态。

item.title: 稀土互金属 RMn₂Ge₂（R=Ce、Pr、Nd）的局域磁性性质
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 N. P. Bentley, T. L. Breeze, A. Hernández-Melián, M. J. Pearce, T. J. Hicken, M. T. F. Telling, B. M. Huddart, D. A. Mayoh, G. Balakrishnan, S. J. Clark, T. Lancaster
本文研究了稀土互金属材料 RMn₂Ge₂（R=Ce、Pr、Nd），这些材料据报道在室温下支持斯格明子气泡晶格。三种材料的磁性都表现为：随着温度升高，磁态由锥形磁结构转变为共线反铁磁结构时，局域涨落开始出现。在这一已报道为斯格明子气泡纹理存在的温区内，观测到与其他斯格明子宿主材料相似的动力学行为。

item.title: 利用超导控制元件实现温度可调的自旋波折射
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pim H. Vree (Department of Quantum Nanoscience, Kavli Institute of Nanoscience, Delft University of Technology, 2628 CJ Delft, The Netherlands), Merel A. Bouma (Department of Quantum Nanoscience, Kavli Institute of Nanoscience, Delft University of Technology, 2628 CJ Delft, The Netherlands), Michael Borst (Department of Quantum Nanoscience, Kavli Institute of Nanoscience, Delft University of Technology, 2628 CJ Delft, The Netherlands), Tomas T. Osterholt (Institute for Theoretical Physics, Utrecht University, 3584 CC Utrecht, The Netherlands), Rembert A. Duine (Institute for Theoretical Physics, Utrecht University, 3584 CC Utrecht, The Netherlands), Toeno van der Sar (Department of Quantum Nanoscience, Kavli Institute of Nanoscience, Delft University of Technology, 2628 CJ Delft, The Netherlands)
该工作利用超导控制元件的磁屏蔽作用来调节局域自旋波色散，从而在薄膜磁绝缘体中实现温度可控的自旋波折射。基于钻石中自旋的磁成像，作者表征了折射率，并演示了正折射、负折射以及由超导体塑形的波前。结果表明，超导体可充当可调自旋波光学元件。

item.title: 二维超导体中由相位涨落与尺度层级产生的涌现磁性赝能隙
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xu-Cheng Wang, Yang Qi
预成对与相位涨落被认为在预测二维超导体正常态中的电荷赝能隙方面起着重要作用。本文在此基础上进一步提出，纯粹由相位涨落即可产生涌现磁性赝能隙，而无需引入任何竞争序。我们通过微扰理论计算泡图贡献和一阶顶角修正，研究 NMR 弛豫率 1/T₁T。

item.title: 磁性滑移铁电体中的分数量子自旋铁电与滑移自旋电流
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yilin Han, Lei Li, Chaoxi Cui, Run-Wu Zhang, Zhi-Ming Yu, Yugui Yao
本文研究磁性滑移铁电体中的分数量子自旋铁电（FSFE）现象。在这类体系中，铁电翻转不仅表现为面外电极化的反转，还伴随着分数量化的面内自旋电子极化变化。我们表明，FSFE 中的层间滑移可以自然地产生一种由对称性保护的纯自旋流，称为滑移自旋电流。

item.title: 交替磁体中的 II 型镜面对称陈绝缘体
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Amrita Mukherjee, Pritesh Srivastava, Rahul Verma, Bahadur Singh
该研究预言二维交替磁体中存在一种由镜面对称保护的拓扑晶体绝缘体，其边缘模在动量空间中分离。基于方形-八边形晶格模型，作者表明交替磁有序可产生谷极化狄拉克节点，并在自旋轨道耦合作用下形成镜面陈数 CM=2 的绝缘相。论文进一步提出 PbSe/V₂Se₂O 异质双层作为可能材料平台。

item.title: 极化畸变对反铁磁α-MnTe线性与非线性反常霍尔电导的影响
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mathews Benny, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi, Amar Fakhredine, Chanchal K. Barman, Carmine Autieri
具有奈尔矢量沿 y 轴的代替磁性 α-MnTe 具有有限的反常霍尔电导和沿 z 轴的弱铁磁性。本文指出，在表面上，晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的相互作用会将空间群从六方 P6₃/mmc 降低为正交 Amm2。作者进一步研究了电场诱导的极化与内禀反常霍尔效应的耦合，表明极化效应可显著改变反常霍尔电导，并与非线性反常霍尔效应共存。

item.title: 近乎平带中由量子几何驱动的精确铁磁基态
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Taisei Kitamura, Hiroki Nakai, Hosho Katsura, Ryotaro Arita
本文构造了一个 Hubbard 模型，其中近乎平带的量子几何可以独立于能量色散和库仑相互作用进行调控。作者证明，在该近乎平带半填充时，模型的精确基态呈现铁磁性，而且这种铁磁性由量子度量通过自旋刚度所稳定。进一步地，仅调控量子几何就足以驱动磁相变，揭示了铁磁性的量子几何起源。

item.title: 反铁磁斯格明子相互作用的时间分辨成像
item.description:
📚 Nature Physics
👤 Mona Bhukta, Takaaki Dohi, Kilian Leutner, Maria-Andromachi Syskaki, Fabian Kammerbauer, Duc Minh Tran 等16位作者
反铁磁斯格明子相互作用的时间分辨动力学一直难以直接观测，这限制了对其集体行为的调控。该工作在薄膜多层结构中实时可视化了其超快动力学，为理解和操控反铁磁斯格明子提供了新手段。

item.title: Pr2Sn2O7 中由无序诱导的近邻量子自旋冰相
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yi Luo, Brenden R. Ortiz, Miles J. Knudtson, Stephen D. Wilson, Jue Liu, Benjamin A. Frandsen, Si Athena Chen, Matthias D. Frontzek, Andrey A. Podlesnyak, Joseph A. M. Paddison, Adam A. Aczel
本文结合体性质表征和单晶中子散射，研究了非 Kramers 稀土磁性焦绿石 Pr2Sn2O7。结果表明，在低于约 1 K 时，体系呈现量子自旋冰的特征，包括各向异性的自旋冰关联和两种不同的动力学时间尺度；但进一步降温后，体系在约 0.15 K 发生完全自旋冻结。该冻结伴随核 Schottky 异常的恢复、带隙磁激发的出现以及初现的 (100) 磁关联，说明无序会驱动量子自旋冰向冻结基态演化。

item.title: 共价体相 WN₂ 中的净与隐含自旋-谷锁定实现超高空穴迁移率
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rong-Tian Pang, Zhongjuan Han, Jiayi Gong, Jiangang He, Jin-Jian Zhou, Yugui Yao
室温下的高载流子迁移率是高性能电子学的基础，但高空穴迁移率在体相半导体中仍十分罕见。自旋-谷锁定能够抑制谷间散射并提高迁移率，但它通常只存在于破缺反演对称性的材料中。隐含自旋极化提供了一条突破这一限制的可能路径，不过其补偿性的自旋纹理是否能够保护电荷输运仍不清楚。

item.title: 用于 Dirac 方程格子 Boltzmann 实现的精确量子线路
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Nilesh Sawant, Ethan Young, Kevin Griffin, Michael Martin
该研究将 Succi-Dellar 量子格子 Boltzmann 格式的三维 Dirac 演化显式映射为门模型量子线路。作者给出了旋转、碰撞、流动位移、位置相关势以及周期和反射边界条件等操作的门级构造，并在状态矢量模拟器上达到与经典 QLB 求解器机器精度一致的结果。论文强调该工作证明了可实现性并报告门数，但不主张计算优势。

item.title: 在 256 量子比特处理器上探索二维量子磁体的弛豫图景
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tiago Mendes-Santos, Joseph Vovrosh, Sergi Julià-Farré, Dorian Claveau, Guillaume Villaret, Lucas Béguin, Lucas Leclerc, Laurin Brunner, Wladislaw Krinitsin, Matthias Hecker, Fergus Hayes, Boris Albrecht, Lilian Bourachot, Clémence Briosne-Frejaville, Antoine Cornillot, Julius de Hond, Djibril Diallo, Clément Dupays, Robin Dupont, Thomas Eritzpokhoff, Loïc Henriet, Lucas Lassablière, Arvid Lindberg, Yohann Machu, Hadriel Mamann, Thomas Pansiot, Julien Ripoll, Bruno Ximenez, Henrique Silvério, Joseph Tindall, Markus Schmitt, Markus Heyl, Adrien Signoles, Constantin Dalyac, Antoine Browaeys, Alexandre Dauphin
该研究利用 256 量子比特二维 Rydberg 原子阵列，绘制二维横场 Ising 模型在相图中的远离平衡弛豫图景。除预期的快速热化外，作者还识别出由有效 XY 模型支配的预热化区以及一个出人意料的弛豫减慢交叉区。该减慢区恰好位于经典张量网络方法在长时间失控的位置，显示 Rydberg 阵列可用于发现非平衡多体动力学中的新现象。

👤 Lavoisier Wah, Ayan Banerjee, Flore K. Kunst

item.title: Spin Qubits in Photon-Coupled Microwave Cavities
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Samuel Johnson, Nancy Sandler
arXiv:2608.06859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron spin qubits in microwave cavities provide a promising platform for scalable quantum computing hardware, leveraging long coherence times, charge-noise robustness and cavity mediated qubit-qubit interactions. item.description:

item.title: Suppression of orbital ordering and emergence of a glassy magnetic state in a high-entropy spinel vanadate
item.description:
📚 arXiv
